title: Insights
summary: Reports from {pos}'s analytics in one hub: what each one is for, who can see it, and where the numbers come from.

blocks.text: Insights are reports built from {pos}'s own analytics service. Open the **Insights** hub and pick a tile; your last choice is remembered. An admin grants them with the **Sales insights** access on Users.

items: [Daily compare](article:insights-daily): one day against last week, the 4-week average and last year.
[Prep forecast](article:insights-prep): how many of each kitchen item to expect on a day.
[Menu trends](article:insights-menu-trends): risers, fallers and items that didn't sell.
[Add-ons](article:insights-addons): every modifier and its attach rate.
[Returning customers](article:insights-returning): how many cards came back.
[Loss watch](article:insights-loss-watch) and [Odd checks](article:insights-odd-checks): admins only, because they name employees.

blocks.text: Four more sit together under **Also in {pos}**: Sales channels, Check size & guests, Busy hours and Best & worst sellers. They repeat {pos}'s own reports and are kept here for convenience. See [Also in {pos}](article:insights-also-in-pos).

items: Each report says "From {pos} Analytics, updated ..." at the top.
A past day is read once and saved. The last 14 days are read again each night at 4:30 AM, because {pos} keeps changing days after they close.
Today is read live and reused for a minute or two.
If {pos} doesn't answer, the last saved copy shows with a yellow note.
{pos}'s analytics run 2 to 4 hours behind and count by {pos}'s business day (ending at 4 AM), so totals can differ by a few dollars from Items Sold.

blocks.text: With Hide sales numbers you see only the reports without dollar amounts: Prep forecast, Returning customers and Busy hours (as order counts).
